title: what the plugin says about itself is true
description: Tasks: (1) SECURITY.md names the five open secret-read shapes listed as Known open in 2.3.0 at class level, and corrects the post-detection sentence about commands 'provably unable to write'; the documented-gap rows become a characterization test in the repo. (2) Fix false claims: usage --backfill 'writes nothing', status.md's nonexistent /audit:run-gate, examples/README 'never dirties the tree', tests/_harness.py 'macos in CI', the fsync docstring in _manifest_io. (3) QUICKSTART is the only quick-start; other docs link to it; the README's first screen states who it is for and who does not need it. (4) Re-record the demo GIF and give it a text digest in captured-at.json so its words cannot rot unseen. (5) CONTRIBUTING gets a one-page 'Your first change'; add issue and PR templates. (6) Decision record: optional modules (panel, usage views, ADO, demo, theme editor) get fixes only, no new features, until a user asks; no new UI shape pins; no new prose lints.
desiredOutcome: every documented claim a reader acts on matches the code: SECURITY.md names the known open read shapes, the README, QUICKSTART, examples and comments make no false claim, there is one quick-start, the demo shows today's text, and a newcomer and a contributor each have a one-page start
